task: Unclog a sink or tub drain
steps: Remove the stopper and pull out visible hair/gunk by hand.
Try a plunger with the overflow hole covered for a tight seal.
If still clogged, remove the P-trap under the sink and clear it into a bucket.
Use a hand-crank drain auger/snake for anything deeper in the line.
Avoid chemical drain cleaners; they can damage pipes and are a plumber safety hazard.
